description: Synthetic frame-level dB and Silero probabilities for recorder integration; no recorded audio or telemetry is included.

whisperClassLostBySilero.description: Twelve seconds of sustained +35 dB speech energy over a -70 dB floor with a silent Silero stream, followed by 1.5 seconds of quiet.

shortFrameEnergyOnset.description: 2.55 seconds of +35 dB energy over a -70 dB floor in 85 ms frames, then quiet; recorder onset confirmation is tested at 120 and 500 ms.

energyBearingEndpointTailOverCap.description: Five 100 ms Silero speech frames followed by two seconds of +10 dB trailing audio; post-roll tail promotion exceeds a one-second test cap.

shortBreathsAndJunk.description: Four separated 200 ms breaths at +25 dB over a -70 dB floor, each followed by 300 ms below the onset margin.

ordinarySileroSpeech.description: 1.5 seconds of Silero-confirmed speech at +25 dB over a -70 dB floor, followed by four seconds of silence.

retainedEnergyTailWithoutOnset.description: One 100 ms frame at +10 dB over a -70 dB floor: energy-bearing for retention, but below the +30 dB onset threshold.

retainedEnergyOverCap.description: 61.1 seconds of continuous +10 dB energy over a -70 dB floor, below onset but above the retention evidence bar.
